knowledge_base: Knowledge Base Grounded Chat is positioned as a Enterprise AI starter that emphasizes fast iteration, clear documentation, and production-friendly interfaces.
The primary value proposition is: Build a grounded chat layer on top of curated content with simple retrieval and answer generation.
Recommended operating model: ship a small API, add observability, validate outputs with stakeholder review, and monitor the top business KPI every week.
Typical stakeholders include analytics, operations, product, and leadership teams working on chat, grounded, knowledge.
